text_block_list.text:
"Ore," "watashi"... Multiple words for
"I"...
"After-school ramen" is a phrase of
invitation.
Intel complete.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
The problem is question tags—"right?"
"Isn't it?"
"Y'know?" ...These remain
difficult to utilize.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Complete fluency in Japanese... That's
my highest
priority. Continuing mission...
